ridge_alpha.fact: For Ridge, increasing alpha strengthens L2 regularization; decreasing alpha weakens it. Validation must determine quality.

windows.fact: D/history_steps is training history; L/input_steps is model input context; H is the fixed business forecast horizon. Changing D or L does not change H.

adaptation.fact: Zero-shot does not update base weights on task data. Chronos LoRA, planning-LLM SFT and encoder/GP adaptation are separate procedures.

batch.fact: Physical batch controls each device step. Effective batch also depends on accumulation and devices; unsupported accumulation cannot be proposed. Smaller physical batch may reduce activation memory, but must be measured.

labels.fact: Missing or immature labels mean insufficient evaluation evidence, not poor predictions. Never impute supervised truth or invent a quality score for an execution failure.

correlation.fact: Correlation and autocorrelation suggest testable features, not causal roots, machine states or calibrated uncertainty.
